rationale: PRIMARY: Ile5,6-deltorphin II raised delta-selectivity to 2400-18000x (Sasaki 1991; Nevin 1994). beta-branched, more hydrophobic.
hydrophobicity control: same added bulk, NOT beta-branched. Separates hydrophobicity from beta-branching.
deltorphin I address (DVVG) vs deltorphin II (EVVG); both natural, highly delta-selective. Shorter anionic side chain.
combinatorial best-guess: tests additivity of the two independent levers.
true deltorphin length (7-mer). Native has D-Ala2; plasmid can only encode L-Ala, so this tests the register penalty.
